description: This Java class 'WaveState' models the state of a waveform in engine trigger detection, handling signal transitions, storing transition data, and providing timing information.

classes.name: WaveState
classes.description: Represents the waveform state, handling signal transitions (up/down), maintaining a list of transition events, and calculating maximum timing information.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a signal transition (up or down) at a specified angle, updating internal state and recording events.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Handles wrap-around cases by inserting a cross-over event at the start of the list when a down signal is pending.

methods.name: getMaxTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum 'down' time among the recorded events.
